blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Water: Complete Training Edition (Part 2)

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives — Part B
blocks.en: Learning Objectives — Part B

blocks.zh: 理解水系統驗證生命週期（DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ）的各階段目的與要求
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and requirements of each stage of the water system validation lifecycle (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ)

blocks.zh: 掌握水系統三階段性能確認（PQ Phase 1/2/3）的策略與時間安排
blocks.en: Understand the strategy and timing of the three-phase performance qualification of water systems (PQ Phase 1/2/3)

blocks.zh: 了解 PW 和 WFI 系統的主要單元操作（unit operations）及其微生物控制重點
blocks.en: Know the main unit operations of PW and WFI systems and their microbial control priorities

blocks.zh: 理解系統材料選擇（MOC）、消毒方式（熱、化學、UV）對水質的影響
blocks.en: Understand how the choice of materials of construction (MOC) and the sanitization method (heat, chemical, UV) affect water quality

blocks.zh: 掌握 TOC 和導電度測試的原理，以及 Stage 1/2/3 導電度測試流程
blocks.en: Understand the principles of TOC and conductivity testing, and the Stage 1/2/3 conductivity test procedure

blocks.zh: 了解化學評估中 Sterile Water 的特殊導電度和 TOC 規格
blocks.en: Know the special conductivity and TOC specifications for Sterile Waters in the chemical evaluation

blocks.zh: Section 4 — Validation and Qualification of Water Systems 水系統驗證與確認
blocks.en: Section 4 — Validation and Qualification of Water Systems

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 水系統驗證生命週期
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Water System Validation Lifecycle

blocks.zh: 水系統驗證遵循標準的製藥驗證生命週期模型，通常分為三個主要階段：
blocks.en: Water system validation follows the standard pharmaceutical validation lifecycle model, which is usually divided into three main stages:

blocks.zh: 設計階段：DQ（設計確認）+ URS（使用者需求規格）
blocks.en: Design stage: DQ (design qualification) + URS (user requirement specification)

blocks.zh: 安裝/操作確認：IQ（安裝確認）+ OQ（操作確認）
blocks.en: Installation/operational qualification: IQ (installation qualification) + OQ (operational qualification)

blocks.zh: 性能確認：PQ Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3（長期監控）
blocks.en: Performance qualification: PQ Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3 (long-term monitoring)

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 建議的 PQ 三階段策略（傳統 Approach）：
blocks.en: The three-phase PQ strategy recommended by USP <1231> (traditional approach):

blocks.zh: Phase 1（2–4 週）：強化監控，建立基準線，確認系統能穩定生產
blocks.en: Phase 1 (2–4 weeks): intensified monitoring to establish a baseline and confirm the system can produce water consistently

blocks.zh: Phase 2（再 2–4 週）：繼續監控，跨越各種操作狀態（如消毒後）
blocks.en: Phase 2 (another 2–4 weeks): continued monitoring across the various operating states (for example, after sanitization)

blocks.zh: Phase 3（1 年以上）：降低監控頻率至例行水準，包含季節性變異
blocks.en: Phase 3 (1 year or more): monitoring frequency reduced to the routine level, covering seasonal variation

blocks.zh: 水系統驗證文件架構 Validation Documentation
blocks.en: Validation Documentation

blocks.zh:
驗證主計畫 (VMP)
  └─ 水系統驗證計畫 (Water System Validation Plan)
       ├─ URS（使用者需求規格）
       ├─ DQ 報告
       ├─ IQ 協議 + 報告
       ├─ OQ 協議 + 報告（含 FAT/SAT）
       ├─ PQ 協議 + 報告（Phase 1/2/3）
       └─ 驗證總結報告 (Validation Summary Report)
blocks.en:
Validation Master Plan (VMP)
  └─ Water System Validation Plan
       ├─ URS (user requirement specification)
       ├─ DQ report
       ├─ IQ protocol + report
       ├─ OQ protocol + report (including FAT/SAT)
       ├─ PQ protocol + report (Phase 1/2/3)
       └─ Validation Summary Report

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — OQ 的關鍵要素
blocks.en: Key Notes — Key Elements of OQ

blocks.zh: OQ 階段是「設備功能測試」的最後關卡，必須在 OQ 完成後才能進入 PQ（產品/水質測試）。OQ 的重點包括：報警功能確認（alarm verification）、控制序列確認（control sequence verification）、操作範圍確認（operating range）。特別重要的是：OQ 完成時，所有 SOP 必須已到位、操作員訓練必須完成——這是常見的驗證查廠 deficiency 項目。
blocks.en: OQ is the last gate of "equipment functional testing", and PQ (product/water quality testing) can begin only after OQ is complete. The focus of OQ includes alarm verification, control sequence verification, and operating range verification. Particularly important: when OQ is completed, all SOPs must be in place and operator training must be complete. This is a common validation deficiency raised in inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — PQ 的三階段
blocks.en: Analogy — The Three Phases of PQ

blocks.zh: PQ 三階段就像新進員工的「試用期管理」：Phase 1 是密集觀察（每天報到），Phase 2 是常規監督（每週 check-in），Phase 3 是正式轉正（按季度考核）。水系統也一樣——剛啟動時必須密集監控，確認系統穩定後才能降低監控頻率，但從不停止監控。
blocks.en: The three phases of PQ are like "probation management" for a new employee: Phase 1 is intensive observation (reporting in every day), Phase 2 is routine supervision (a weekly check-in), and Phase 3 is the formal confirmation (a quarterly review). The same applies to a water system: right after startup it must be monitored intensively, and only after it is confirmed to be stable can the monitoring frequency be reduced, but monitoring never stops.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 新廠房啟動時，水系統驗證通常是商業批次生產的先決條件（prerequisite）。常見的計畫錯誤是低估 PQ Phase 1 的時間——USP 要求「至少 2–4 週，且需涵蓋系統的各種操作狀態」。若新廠在冬季完成安裝並開始 PQ，必須確認 PQ Phase 3 能涵蓋夏季（季節性微生物負荷高峰），否則需要補充驗證數據。
blocks.en: When a new CDMO facility starts up, water system validation is usually a prerequisite for commercial batch production. A common planning mistake is underestimating the time needed for PQ Phase 1: USP calls for "at least 2–4 weeks, covering the various operating states of the system". If a new plant completes installation in winter and begins PQ then, you must confirm that PQ Phase 3 will cover the summer (the seasonal peak of microbial load); otherwise supplementary validation data are needed.

blocks.zh: Section 4.3 — Operational Use: Monitoring, Maintenance & Change Control 操作維護與變更控制
blocks.en: Section 4.3 — Operational Use: Monitoring, Maintenance & Change Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 驗證維護的持續性
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Keeping the Validated State Continuous

blocks.zh: USP 強調「驗證」不是一次性活動，而是持續性的生命週期管理。水系統進入常規使用後，需要維持的三大支柱：
blocks.en: USP emphasizes that "validation" is not a one-time activity but continuous lifecycle management. Once a water system enters routine use, three pillars must be maintained:

blocks.zh: 持續監控（Ongoing Monitoring）：PC + QC 取樣，建立趨勢，偵測異常
blocks.en: Ongoing Monitoring: PC + QC sampling to establish trends and detect anomalies

blocks.zh: 預防性維護（Preventive Maintenance）：過濾器更換、膜清洗、UV 燈更換、校準
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance: filter replacement, membrane cleaning, UV lamp replacement, calibration

blocks.zh: 變更控制（Change Control）：任何設備、管路、操作參數變更都需評估再驗證範圍
blocks.en: Change Control: any change to equipment, piping, or operating parameters requires an assessment of the scope of revalidation

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 週期性回顧
blocks.en: Key Notes — Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 水系統的 Annual Product Review（APR）/ Annual Review 是 FDA 和 EU GMP 的明確要求。這個回顧必須包含：所有 OOS 事件分析、消毒頻率是否適當、維護歷史、校準記錄和趨勢分析。若回顧顯示系統持續超出 Alert Level，可能觸發再驗證（re-qualification）的需求。
blocks.en: The Annual Product Review (APR) / Annual Review of the water system is an explicit requirement of FDA and EU GMP. The review must include analysis of all OOS events, whether the sanitization frequency is appropriate, the maintenance history, calibration records, and trend analysis. If the review shows that the system is persistently exceeding Alert Levels, it may trigger the need for re-qualification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 變更控制的重要性
blocks.en: Analogy — Why Change Control Matters

blocks.zh: 水系統的變更控制就像飛機的適航維護——任何非計畫的零件更換或系統修改，都必須記錄在案並評估安全影響。一個看似微小的管路延長（dead leg 增加）或閥門更換，都可能改變水系統的流動特性和消毒效果，進而影響微生物控制。
blocks.en: Change control for a water system is like airworthiness maintenance for an aircraft: any unplanned part replacement or system modification must be documented and assessed for its safety impact. Even a seemingly minor change, such as extending a pipe run (adding a dead leg) or replacing a valve, can alter the flow characteristics and sanitization effectiveness of the water system, and in turn affect microbial control.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 WFI 系統的循環泵需要緊急更換（型號相同但廠商不同），這是否需要啟動變更控制？需要哪些再驗證活動？
blocks.en: If the circulation pump of a WFI system must be replaced urgently (same model but a different manufacturer), does change control need to be initiated? Which requalification activities are needed?

blocks.zh: 水系統連續 3 個月的微生物數據顯示接近 Action Level，週期性回顧應提出什麼建議？
blocks.en: The microbial data of a water system have been close to the Action Level for 3 consecutive months. What should the periodic review recommend?

blocks.zh: Section 5 — Design and Operation of PW and WFI Systems 系統設計與操作
blocks.en: Section 5 — Design and Operation of PW and WFI Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 單元操作流程
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Sequence of Unit Operations

blocks.zh: 典型 PW/WFI 系統的單元操作序列（由前到後）：
blocks.en: The sequence of unit operations in a typical PW/WFI system (from front to back):

blocks.zh: 原水 → 預過濾（Prefiltration）
blocks.en: Source water → Prefiltration

blocks.zh: → 活性碳（Activated Carbon）— 去除氯
blocks.en: → Activated Carbon — removes chlorine

blocks.zh: → 軟化器（Softener）— 去除硬水
blocks.en: → Softener — removes hardness

blocks.zh: → 逆滲透（RO，通常 2 段）— 去離子、有機物、微生物
blocks.en: → Reverse osmosis (RO, usually 2 passes) — removes ions, organics, and microorganisms

blocks.zh: → UV 254nm — 降低 TOC 或消毒
blocks.en: → UV 254nm — reduces TOC or sanitizes

blocks.zh: → 去離子（DI/EDI）— 精密去離子
blocks.en: → Deionization (DI/EDI) — polishing deionization

blocks.zh: → 超過濾（UF）— 去除內毒素（WFI 路線）
blocks.en: → Ultrafiltration (UF) — removes endotoxin (WFI route)

blocks.zh: → 蒸餾（Distillation）— WFI 傳統路線
blocks.en: → Distillation — traditional WFI route

blocks.zh: → 儲槽（Storage Tank）→ 配水系統（Distribution Loop）
blocks.en: → Storage Tank → Distribution Loop

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 活性碳的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key Notes — Microbial Risk of Activated Carbon

blocks.zh: 活性碳床（Activated Carbon Bed）是水系統中最容易形成生物膜的單元，因為它提供了大表面積且能吸附微生物賴以生長的有機物（包括它所吸附的氯也被移除，消除了抑菌效果）。USP 建議：以熱水或蒸汽消毒，或考慮使用替代技術（UV 去氯 + 有機掃除型離子交換樹脂）來規避這個風險。
blocks.en: The activated carbon bed is the unit in a water system most prone to biofilm formation, because it provides a large surface area and adsorbs the organic substances on which microorganisms grow (and the chlorine it removes also eliminates the bacteriostatic effect). USP recommends sanitizing with hot water or steam, or considering alternative technologies (UV dechlorination + organic-scavenging ion exchange resin) to avoid this risk.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — RO 膜的限制
blocks.en: Key Notes — Limitations of RO Membranes

blocks.zh: 單段 RO 通常無法達到 PW 的導電度規格（≤1.3 µS/cm），這是因為 RO 的拒絕率（rejection rate）約 95–99%，取決於操作條件。工廠通常採用「雙段 RO（double-pass RO）」或「RO + EDI（電去離子）」來確保達標。注意：RO 不能有效去除所有 VOCs（揮發性有機物），若原水含有特殊有機物污染，需要在 RO 前後加裝活性碳或 UV/H₂O₂ 系統。
blocks.en: A single-pass RO usually cannot meet the PW conductivity specification (≤1.3 µS/cm), because the rejection rate of RO is about 95–99%, depending on operating conditions. Plants usually use "double-pass RO" or "RO + EDI (electrodeionization)" to ensure compliance. Note: RO does not effectively remove all VOCs (volatile organic compounds); if the source water contains special organic contamination, an activated carbon or UV/H₂O₂ system must be added before or after the RO.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 儲槽的呼吸器
blocks.en: Analogy — The Breather of the Storage Tank

blocks.zh: 水系統儲槽的排氣過濾器（vent filter）就像人的「鼻子」——儲槽水位上下波動時，必須允許空氣進出。但這個「鼻子」必須有過濾功能（0.2 µm 親水疏水膜），防止外界微生物進入。若排氣過濾器被蒸汽冷凝水阻塞，儲槽就「無法呼吸」，嚴重時可能導致槽體壓扁變形（負壓崩塌）。這就是為什麼儲槽排氣過濾器需要定期更換和熱追蹤（heat tracing）。
blocks.en: The vent filter of a water system storage tank is like a person's "nose": when the water level in the tank rises and falls, air must be allowed to move in and out. But this "nose" must have a filtering function (0.2 µm hydrophilic-hydrophobic membrane) to keep external microorganisms out. If the vent filter is blocked by steam condensate, the tank "cannot breathe", and in severe cases the tank may be crushed and deformed (vacuum collapse). This is why tank vent filters need regular replacement and heat tracing.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的水系統設計審查（design review）時，以下幾點是常見的疏漏：(1) 活性碳床缺少取樣口或缺少消毒連接；(2) 儲槽缺少噴球（spray ball）或噴球覆蓋不完整；(3) 排氣過濾器缺少壓差監控或無破盤報警（rupture disk alarm）；(4) 死角（dead leg）長度超過 6D（管徑的6倍），違反 ISPE Baseline Guide 要求。
blocks.en: In design reviews of CDMO water systems, the following are common oversights: (1) the activated carbon bed lacks a sampling port or a sanitization connection; (2) the tank lacks a spray ball, or the spray ball coverage is incomplete; (3) the vent filter lacks differential pressure monitoring or has no rupture disk alarm; (4) dead leg length exceeds 6D (6 times the pipe diameter), contrary to the ISPE Baseline Guide.

blocks.zh: Section 5.2–5.4 — Materials, Sanitization & Operation 材料選擇、消毒與操作控制
blocks.en: Section 5.2–5.4 — Materials, Sanitization & Operation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — MOC 不鏽鋼標準
blocks.en: Key Concepts — MOC Stainless Steel Standards

blocks.zh: 製藥水系統的材料選擇（Material of Construction, MOC）核心要求：
blocks.en: Core requirements for the materials of construction (MOC) of pharmaceutical water systems:

blocks.zh: 金屬材料：316L 不鏽鋼（SS316L）是主流選擇，電拋光（electropolish）表面粗糙度 Ra ≤ 0.5 µm（WFI 要求更嚴）
blocks.en: Metallic materials: 316L stainless steel (SS316L) is the mainstream choice, electropolished, with surface roughness Ra ≤ 0.5 µm (stricter for WFI)

blocks.zh: 接觸水的非金屬：PTFE、PVDF、矽膠墊片（確認符合 FDA 21 CFR 177 或 EU 10/2011）
blocks.en: Non-metallics in contact with water: PTFE, PVDF, silicone gaskets (confirm compliance with FDA 21 CFR 177 or EU 10/2011)

blocks.zh: 禁止：螺紋接頭（dead space risk）、PVC（可能釋放鄰苯二甲酸酯）、不相容金屬（chloride SCC 風險）
blocks.en: Prohibited: threaded joints (dead space risk), PVC (may release phthalates), incompatible metals (chloride SCC risk)

blocks.zh: 三種消毒方式比較 Sanitization Method Comparison
blocks.en: Sanitization Method Comparison

                distribution     validation             on its own

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 化學消毒的殘留去除
blocks.en: Key Notes — Residue Removal After Chemical Sanitization

blocks.zh: 化學消毒（尤其是臭氧 O₃）必須驗證消毒劑在使用前已完全去除（通常用 UV 254nm 分解臭氧，或等待自然分解後取樣確認）。如果消毒劑殘留進入成品，可能造成藥物降解或患者安全問題。USP 特別要求：消毒劑的分析方法需要在驗證計畫中明確，包含殘留的偵測和定量方法。
blocks.en: For chemical sanitization (ozone O₃ in particular), you must verify that the sanitizing agent has been completely removed before use (usually by destroying the ozone with UV 254nm, or by waiting for natural decomposition and then sampling to confirm). If sanitant residues enter the finished product, they can degrade the drug or create patient safety problems. USP specifically requires that the analytical methods for the sanitizing agent be defined in the validation plan, including methods for detecting and quantifying the residue.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — UV 的限制
blocks.en: Analogy — The Limits of UV

blocks.zh: UV 消毒就像用「手電筒殺菌」——只對直接照射到的細菌有效，對已在管壁上形成的生物膜完全沒用，因為生物膜有 EPS（胞外多醣）保護層屏蔽。UV 最好的使用場景是「預防性維持」（防止浮游菌積聚），而非「治療性消毒」（殺死已建立的生物膜）。
blocks.en: UV sanitization is like "killing bacteria with a flashlight": it works only on bacteria directly illuminated, and is completely ineffective against biofilm already formed on the pipe wall, because biofilm is shielded by a protective layer of EPS (extracellular polysaccharide). The best use of UV is "preventive maintenance" (preventing planktonic bacteria from accumulating), not "curative sanitization" (killing an established biofilm).

blocks.zh: 一個 PW 系統的微生物計數突然上升，消毒後恢復正常，但下次採樣又升高。這提示什麼根本問題？需要做哪些調查？
blocks.en: The microbial counts of a PW system suddenly rise, return to normal after sanitization, but rise again at the next sampling. What root problem does this suggest? What investigations are needed?

blocks.zh: 新安裝的不鏽鋼管路，IQ 後必須進行哪些處理才能進入 OQ/PQ 階段？
blocks.en: After the IQ of newly installed stainless steel piping, what treatments must be carried out before it can proceed to the OQ/PQ stage?

blocks.zh: Section 7 — Chemical Evaluations 化學評估
blocks.en: Section 7 — Chemical Evaluations

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — TOC + 導電度的現代意義
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Modern Significance of TOC + Conductivity

blocks.zh: 1996 年 USP 的改革，用 TOC 和導電度兩個現代分析技術，取代了以前一大堆個別化學測試（氨、鈣、二氧化碳、氯化物、硫酸鹽...）。
blocks.en: The USP reform of 1996 used two modern analytical techniques, TOC and conductivity, to replace the many individual chemical tests used before (ammonia, calcium, carbon dioxide, chloride, sulfate...).

blocks.zh: 原因：
blocks.en: Reasons:

blocks.zh: TOC 和導電度可以在線連續監控（online/real-time），舊方法只能離線批次測試
blocks.en: TOC and conductivity can be monitored online and continuously (online/real-time), whereas the old methods could only be run offline in batches

blocks.zh: 涵蓋範圍更廣：TOC 偵測有機污染，導電度偵測離子（無機）污染
blocks.en: Wider coverage: TOC detects organic contamination, and conductivity detects ionic (inorganic) contamination

blocks.zh: 這個改變讓廠商可以用在線儀器替代大量實驗室工作，節省成本且更即時
blocks.en: This change lets companies replace a large amount of laboratory work with online instruments, saving cost and giving more immediate results

blocks.zh: 導電度三段測試流程 Conductivity 3-Stage Test
blocks.en: Conductivity 3-Stage Test

blocks.zh:
Stage 1（在線測試，依溫度設限）：
  例：25°C 時，PW/WFI 限度 = 1.3 µS/cm
  → 若通過：合格，可放行
  → 若不通過：進行 Stage 2

Stage 2（實驗室，pH 測定）：
  取水樣，測 pH（5.0–7.0 為可接受範圍）
  → 若 pH 超出範圍：不合格
  → 若 pH 在範圍內：查 Stage 2 對照表

Stage 3（計算各離子貢獻）：
  分別計算 H⁺、OH⁻、HCO₃⁻、Cl⁻、Na⁺、NH₄⁺
  各離子導電度總和 = Combined Stage 3 Limit
  → 若合格：通過
  → 若不合格：水不符規格
blocks.en:
Stage 1 (online test, limit depends on temperature):
  Example: at 25°C, PW/WFI limit = 1.3 µS/cm
  → If it passes: acceptable, may be released
  → If it fails: proceed to Stage 2

Stage 2 (laboratory, pH determination):
  Take a water sample and measure pH (5.0–7.0 is the acceptable range)
  → If pH is outside the range: fails
  → If pH is within the range: consult the Stage 2 table

Stage 3 (calculate the contribution of each ion):
  Calculate H⁺, OH⁻, HCO₃⁻, Cl⁻, Na⁺, NH₄⁺ separately
  Sum of the ionic conductivities = Combined Stage 3 Limit
  → If it passes: acceptable
  → If it fails: the water does not meet the specification

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 無菌水的化學特殊性
blocks.en: Key Notes — The Chemistry of Sterile Waters Is Different

blocks.zh: 無菌水（Sterile Waters）的導電度和 TOC 規格設計的目的不是評估水的原始純度，而是評估包裝材料的浸出物（leachables）。這就是為什麼 USP 〈645〉 對 Sterile Waters 有獨立的規格（通常比 Bulk Waters 寬鬆很多）。重要實務：如果要在實驗室用無菌水配製分析試劑，必須先確認該無菌水的導電度/TOC 是否適合此特定用途，不能假設「符合 monograph 規格 = 適合所有分析用途」。
blocks.en: The conductivity and TOC specifications for Sterile Waters are designed not to assess the original purity of the water but to assess leachables from the packaging material. This is why USP <645> has separate specifications for Sterile Waters (usually much less strict than for Bulk Waters). Important practical point: if you want to use sterile water in the laboratory to prepare analytical reagents, you must first confirm that its conductivity/TOC is suitable for that specific use; you cannot assume that "meeting the monograph specification = suitable for every analytical use".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 導電度測試的意義
blocks.en: Analogy — What the Conductivity Test Means

blocks.zh: 導電度測試就像量「水的電阻」——純水電阻極高（幾乎不導電），任何離子溶入都會降低電阻（增加導電度）。就像在蒸餾水中加一小撮鹽，立即可以感受到水的「電阻降低」。製藥水的導電度規格（≤1.3 µS/cm）非常嚴格，相當於把一粒沙溶進一個游泳池的水量，精度是 ppb 等級。
blocks.en: A conductivity test is like measuring the "electrical resistance of water": pure water has extremely high resistance (it hardly conducts electricity), and any dissolved ion lowers the resistance (raises the conductivity). It is like adding a pinch of salt to distilled water: you can immediately sense the water's "resistance drop". The conductivity specification for pharmaceutical water (≤1.3 µS/cm) is very strict, equivalent to dissolving a grain of sand in the volume of water in a swimming pool, with ppb-level precision.

blocks.zh: WFI 系統的在線導電度儀顯示 1.2 µS/cm（25°C），這個數據可以直接作為 QC 放行依據嗎？需要哪些前提條件？
blocks.en: The online conductivity meter of a WFI system reads 1.2 µS/cm (25°C). Can this value be used directly as the basis for QC release? What preconditions are needed?

blocks.zh: 若 Stage 1 導電度測試失敗，下一步是進行 Stage 2 還是直接判定不合格？
blocks.en: If the Stage 1 conductivity test fails, is the next step to go to Stage 2 or to declare failure directly?

blocks.zh: 一批 Sterile WFI 小瓶（1 mL）的 TOC 測試結果顯示高於 Bulk WFI 規格（500 ppb），這一定是異常嗎？
blocks.en: The TOC test result for a batch of Sterile WFI vials (1 mL) is higher than the Bulk WFI limit (500 ppb). Is this necessarily abnormal?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section B Summary
blocks.en: Section B Summary

blocks.zh: 水系統驗證遵循 DQ→IQ→OQ→PQ 生命週期；PQ 通常分三階段，Phase 1/2 共 4–8 週密集監控，Phase 3 跨越完整年度
blocks.en: Water system validation follows the DQ→IQ→OQ→PQ lifecycle; PQ is usually divided into three phases, with Phases 1/2 giving a total of 4–8 weeks of intensive monitoring and Phase 3 spanning a full year

blocks.zh: 驗證維護是持續性活動：監控計畫 + 預防性維護 + 變更控制 + 週期性回顧，缺一不可
blocks.en: Maintaining the validated state is a continuous activity: monitoring program + preventive maintenance + change control + periodic review; none of them can be omitted

blocks.zh: 水系統單元操作序列：預過濾 → 活性碳 → 軟化 → RO（雙段）→ UV → DI/EDI → UF（WFI）→ 蒸餾（WFI傳統）
blocks.en: Water system unit operation sequence: prefiltration → activated carbon → softening → RO (double-pass) → UV → DI/EDI → UF (WFI) → distillation (traditional WFI)

blocks.zh: 活性碳床是最高微生物風險點；RO 單段通常不足以達標；儲槽排氣過濾器需熱追蹤防堵塞
blocks.en: The activated carbon bed is the highest microbial risk point; single-pass RO is usually not enough to meet the specification; tank vent filters need heat tracing to prevent blockage

blocks.zh: 消毒三種方式：熱水（最佳生物膜控制）、化學（需驗證殘留去除）、UV 254nm（輔助，無法單獨控制生物膜）
blocks.en: Three sanitization methods: hot water (best biofilm control), chemical (residue removal must be validated), UV 254nm (supplementary; cannot control biofilm on its own)

blocks.zh: 1996 年起 USP 以 TOC + 導電度（三段測試）取代傳統化學個別測試，支持在線連續監控
blocks.en: Since 1996 USP has replaced the traditional individual chemical tests with TOC + conductivity (three-stage test), which supports continuous online monitoring

blocks.zh: Sterile Waters 的導電度/TOC 規格反映包裝浸出物，比 Bulk Waters 寬鬆；不可混用評估標準
blocks.en: The conductivity/TOC specifications for Sterile Waters reflect packaging leachables and are less strict than for Bulk Waters; the evaluation criteria must not be mixed

blocks.zh: 水系統材料：316L SS + 電拋光，Ra ≤ 0.5 µm；禁止螺紋接頭；Dead leg ≤ 6D
blocks.en: Water system materials: 316L SS + electropolish, Ra ≤ 0.5 µm; no threaded joints; dead leg ≤ 6D
